about: King Neptune's sign-off again with his trident (two tries, to keep the one that does not glitch).

jobs.speak: Fair winds and following seas, mortals. Until the tide brings us together again.

input.prompt: The animated king from the picture speaking to camera, clear lip movement in time with the voice, natural head movement and blinking. He holds the trident still and upright; the trident, his hand and the sea stay steady.
